scope: Two already trained native36 query/memory backends, both frozen detector frontends and both matched nativeRGB/NovemberIR cues. Each original complete6-snapshot Dev curve selects its own checkpoint before this Test. All normal/off/current-frame-shuffled cases run regardless of Dev sign. No Test-based promotion; historicalTest exposed. Other formal families remain outside this subset.
unavailable_scope: Disables only the native residual. Preserves the complete learned RGB real/null prior and backend lifecycle; it is not assumed equal to plain ByteTrack.
compute_scope: Existing complete current-frame encoded features and point packets, no new encoding, no extra seeds and no GPU processes. Cached replay FPS excludes detector/encoders/points.
